items.title: Comparison and verification after Optuna optimization

source.label: Pinned GitHub inputs + locally refit, verified temporal models
filters: For 2027, the cost is for failure of 27,240 supported items. 15,799 pieces of PU/unknown material are not estimated.
caveats: Historical results were previously inspected; this is not an untouched final holdout.

30trial is a finite range search. Random numbers, calculation control, etc. are fixed. Trials that were interrupted due to failure/execution switching are also recorded, and only successful candidates are adopted.
Annual total bias is evaluated on historical repairs that actually occurred. Future budgets also require predictions of failure probabilities/counts.

evidenceFlow.title: Independent validation
evidenceFlow.text: Passed 80 learning period confirmations, 10 saved model regenerations, recalculation of all indicators and weights, and future repair date/cost change inspections.

evidenceFlow.title: Search and aggregation
evidenceFlow.text: There were 30 trials per model/origin. Inner validation used equal-weight RMSE over the two latest past years. The 2020 cold start used fixed settings because temporal validation was unavailable. Deployment models were refitted on all 2019–2026 data.

evidenceFlow.title: Artifacts
evidenceFlow.text: Selected: ensemble_stable. Code, all trials, settings, and validation: ensemble_training/optuna/results/. Comparison report: ensemble_training/optuna/README.md.
